tasks.label: 1 · Verify install
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}/mobile" && npm run test:unit && npx tsc --noEmit && echo '=== ALL GOOD — proceed to task 2 ==='

tasks.label: 2 · Sign in to Expo
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}/mobile" && npx eas-cli@latest login && npx eas-cli@latest whoami

tasks.label: 3 · Apple sign-in + create iOS credentials
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}/mobile" && npx eas-cli@latest credentials:configure-build --platform ios --profile development
